name: spo-hub-site-governance-report
title: SharePoint Hub Site Governance Report
shortDescription: Generate a tenant-wide report of SharePoint Hub Sites, associated sites, site collection administrators, and execution audit details using certificate-based PnP PowerShell authentication.
longDescription: Creates a timestamped CSV inventory of SharePoint Hub Sites and their associated sites, including site collection administrator details and execution audit information.
